vanished 2019-08-29 4:15 UTC on landfill near Els Hostalets de Pierola, west of Barcelona. Lat: 41.53413391113281; lon: 1.80054497718811
Died 2018-10-29 near Villar les Dombes. See Borni II, Botulism cannot be excluded. Carcass without logger found deep in mud.
Died 2018-09-02 on landfill near Narbonne (see Vitus!). Reason of death unclear, probably accident/poisoning due to waste.
Electrocuted 2017-08-17 late afternoon near Les Borges Blanques (Catalonia)

Vanished 2016-04-17 evening south of Sevilla. Was presumably alive at last contact. 2 ring readings reported from this bird in Spain: 2016-05-10 and 2016-06-16. lat: 37.1511634; lon: -5.9998928
Vanished 2016-09-10 evening south of Marrakesh in mountains
Vanished 2017-09-01 at water basin on landfill in Montoliu de Lleida. Probably drowned.
Dead in nest 2015-06-27 at night
Found dead with heavy wound presumably due to harness. See pictures in archive.
Electrocuted ca. 2016-08-07 near Biebesheim
Electrocuted 30 April 2016 in Lothringen
Vanished 2017-02-02 in coastal region of Nigeria
Died in Gambia/Senegal Dec 2016; presumably shot
Dead since 2018-09-07 in in northern part of village Tamanar (66 km north of Agadir) on roof of a water tower. Reason of death unclear, carcass and logger found. Possibly poisoned.
electrocuted 2019-08-29 in the evening near Salmeron (100km WNW from Madrid, Spain). Logger found.
Found dead in French Pyrenees; electrocuted 2015-08-05
Died 2017-09-22 for unknown reason in Sauer delta near Munchhausen, N-Alsace
Vanished on landfill Lleida in August 2015; lat: 41.5374467; lon: 0.6154543

Electrocuted ca. 2017-09-23 near Pamplona, Spain
Died close to electric pole (presumably electrocuted) near Marrakesh 2016-03-24 at 14:00 UTC
Died 2016-09-14 in Spain (Aragon), predated or probably shot? Hunter's hide nearby.
Electrocuted 60 km south of Lyon 9 Sept 2015
Died 10 Sept 2015 at landfill south of Lleida. Acceleration data indicates rather sickness/poisoning than accident or predator.

endings.death_comment: Last signal 2018-10-24 from field in Saragossa, not moving much. Fate unknown.
Died 2017-12-15 in Catalonia in a wineyard close to a house, no e-pylon around
Killed by eagle (observed by Nomads) in S Morocco 2016-08-29
electrocuted 2019-08-31 late afternoon near Montoliu de Lleida / Spain.
Died close to village of birth. Reason unknown, not insured.

endings.end_comment: Vanished near Moehlin 2016-11-18. Unsuccessful search by Monika Krome and Heidi Schmid. Logger lost.
endings.death_comment: vanished 2016-08-14 in fields 20km east of Basel / CH. Nothing to find at last coordinates or under e-pylons around.
Died close to nest; fungus infection presumed
Died 2016-07-25 11:15 local time west of Baden-Baden by electrocution. Carcass and logger found.
Died for unknown reason in SW Guinea. Logger sent for weeks near road.
Died 7.11.2015 in Mauretania at water hole. See Acc data: weak condition?
Died 2015-08-29 noon in Aragon / Spain. Carcass instantly moved, presumably by animal. Likely predation.
Died by electrocution 2018-08-21 near Ivars d'Urgell in Northern Spain.
Died already in nest, most likely from Aspergillosis, Trichomonas gallinae infection.
Electrocuted near Lleida 24 August 2015
Vanished 2017-06-21 evening in Altmuehltal-Region, Bavaria. Many electric poles aroud, but electrocution not confirmed, logger not found. Lat: 49.1749961; lon: 10.5330669

endings.end_comment: GSM not active. Data can only be downloaded when bird in vicinity
endings.death_comment: logger failed after one month
Died 21 Aug 2015 near Figueres in Spain due to electrocution
Died presumably during (observed) nest fight between parents and foreign storks 20 June 2016 late evening
11.8.2016 electrocuted but still alive in N Catalonia near Massoteres, euthanized after healing complications in bird care centre in Lleida
Died 2015-08-20 S of Zaragoza/Spain most likely predated, see ACC and pictures from recovery place
Died 2015-09-09 from electrocution in S Spain
Vanished in S Spain 2015-10-12; lat:37.2218403; lon: -6.049891

endings.end_comment: logger has not sent GPS data since April 2016

Died 2015-08-07 in the evening by by electrocution along a railway track in Lothringen

endings.end_comment: logger brought to a house, then signal lost

Died 2015-11-18 presumably by electrocution near Lleida
Vanished 2016-11-30 in S Mauretania, lat: 15.5489718; lon: -9.7672337
Presumably killed by predator 2016-09-12 in the late afternoon in Central Spain
Died 29 June 2017 in Catalonia; presumably electrocuted (electric pole nearby) and moved ca. 80m. Logger found

endings.end_comment: logger not yet found, area inaccessible for safety reasons
endings.death_comment: Died 2018-08-31 on landfill near Narbonne / S-France. Reduced movements (measured by ACC) suggest poisoning or injury, presumably in connection with waste.
Vanished 2017-01-02 in Mauretania; probably shot, lat: 16.3716889, long: -9.2810606
Died 2016-08-16, most probably due to collision with something (broken neck)
2018-11-20 dead on landfill in Katalonia, presumably insured or poisoned/sick
Died 2018-03-31 in Tanger (Morocco) close to settlement for unknown reason. Logger found 3 months later with some remains of stork.
Shot 2017-10-06 central Senegal. Logger then moved by man
Electrocuted 2017-08-30/31 during the night near Lleida/Spain
Died from electrocution 2018-08-25 near Lleida. Carcass and logger found.
died 2019-09-23 mid afternoon on an open field near Molina de Aragon, Spain. Was flying at that time - could be predation, but carcass not moved for 3 days.
died 2019-12-01 10:20 on a field 30km west of Lleida, Spain. reason unknown, no e-pylon or power line around. 2019-12-16 logger transported to a park/castle  near Saragossa. No contact with finder.
swallowed toy baloons, found almost dead 2019-06-18 near Bruchsal / SW Germay. Euthanized by vet.
died 2019-11-22 in the late evening near Alvalade, S Portugal. Electrocution confirmed by finder.
Died through electrocution in the morning of 2018-08-18 near Lleida
electrocuted 2019-08-24 in the evening near Vaciamadrid / Spain
Electrocuted 2018-09-14 8km W of Malaga. Logger, carcass and two more electrocution victims found.
died 2019-08-25 in the evening by electrocution in Valls, Tarragona, Spain. Logger found.
presumably hunted the night 2018-10-29 to 30 in S Mauretania, logger brought rapidly to a village.
died 2019-08-12 late afternoon in Courgenay / Switzerland. Reported by ringer as electrocution. Logger not seen, was presumably burnt with carcass.
Died 2018-08-29 in the evening near castellnou de Seana, Catalonia. Vet investigation confirmed electrocution.
died 2019-10-25 in the evening near Germainvilliers (60km W Epinal). Reason not yet clear.
Died by electrocution 2018-08-12 south of Narbonne/S-France. Logger and carcass found.
Dead in nest (Trichomonas?)
vanished  26.September 2018 in SE Mauretania 4km from village West Likleiwat. Presumably hunted, logger probably destroyed, a data gap remains. Lat: 15.9290783 lon: -8.0557614
since 2020-10-22 only very few contacts with bad GSM connection. Seen alive breeding April 2021 in Rheinland-Pfalz.
died 2020-11-08 10:30 in NE Morocco. Reason unknown, 2 minutes of strong movement in unnatural position, then flat ACC line. Also possible: logger could be removed and thrown away by a hunter.
vanished 14.03.2020 in Mauretania lat: 24.7594796; lon: -11.9159818
died in the night 2019-05-18 very early in the morning near Ejea de los Caballeros / Spain; likely predated, no e-pylon around.
died 2019-07-25 not far from place of birth. Most likely electrocution. Stork with ring found under e pole, but logger fpound 150m away in bushes with cut harness.
died north of Kenitra (Morocco) during the night 2020-11-04 to 2020-11-05. reason unknown.
Vanished 2019-11-21 in wetland in Larache, Morocco. Reason unknown. Lat: 35.1890789 long: -6.1254611

started breeding in Deisendorf near Lake of Constance April 2021; data with large gaps due to constantly low battery. No data after 2022-09-17. Seen alive 2023-03-17 at 49.403287°N 8.424037°E. Part of harness with small part of logger hanging at breast, logger in correct position.
Logger failure after April 2022. Bird has been observed afterwards. No more in 2023.
died 2019-07-28 at 4:40 local time. Probably collision with low voltage line.
died 2019-08-23 late morning near Thuir, France. Presumably exhaustion (reported by finder).
died by electrocution 2020-09-04 20:10 local time in central Spain.
died not far from nest due to electrocution 2019-07-17.
